server.name: io.github.whatevercat-creator/crypto-sentiment-x402
server.description: Crypto news sentiment for 24 coins: label, score and headlines behind it, paid per call via x402

environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key ID (portal.cdp.coinbase.com). Used to sign x402 payments from your own wallet. Only needed for the paid tools (crypto_sentiment, get_hourly_history); the free tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key secret, paired with CDP_API_KEY_ID. Only needed for the paid tools (crypto_sentiment, get_hourly_history); the free tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Name of the CDP wallet to create/reuse for payments. Defaults to "crypto-sentiment-mcp-wallet". Must hold USDC (+ a little ETH for gas) on the configured network.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the deployed sentiment API. Defaults to https://crypto-sentiment-x402.onrender.com.
environmentVariables.name: SENTIMENT_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: "mainnet" (default, real USDC on Base) or "testnet" (free Base Sepolia USDC).
environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: payTo address the paid tools expect in the 402; anything else is refused before signing. Defaults to the hosted API's wallet. Set it when SENTIMENT_API_URL points at your own deployment.
environmentVariables.name: SENTIMENT_PAY_TO
